elements.name: Rod of Seven Parts
elements.desc:
Rod, Artifact (Requires Attunement)

This rod is a potent artifact of law, shattered into seven pieces during an ancient war. Each piece has its own properties, and the rod grows in power as the pieces are reassembled. While holding one piece of the broken rod, you know the general location of the next consecutive piece, as the rod yearns to be a complete artifact.

**Random Properties.** While attuned to the rod, you gain the following benefits:
- You have advantage on saving throws against spells.
- The rod has 7 charges and regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn.

**Piece Spells.** Each piece of the rod has a spell associated with it. You can expend charges to cast these spells (save DC 20): First Piece (Commune, 1 charge), Second Piece (Arcane Gate, 2 charges), Third Piece (Reverse Gravity, 3 charges), Fourth Piece (Regenerate, 4 charges), Fifth Piece (Demiplane, 5 charges), Sixth Piece (Meteor Swarm, 6 charges), Seventh Piece (Time Stop, 7 charges).

**Destroying the Rod.** The rod can be destroyed only if all seven pieces are brought together and then subjected to the combined power of a wish spell and the breath weapon of a metallic dragon.

elements.name: Chime of Exile
elements.desc:
Wondrous item, Very Rare

This silver chime is engraved with delicate magic sigils. While holding the chime, you can use an action to cast the Banishment spell (spell save DC 20). If the target of the spell has 50 hit points or fewer, it automatically fails its saving throw. Once the chime has been used to cast the spell, it can’t be used this way again until the next dawn.

elements.name: Crown of Lies
elements.desc:
Wondrous item, Legendary (Requires Attunement)

This jagged, obsidian crown is cold to the touch and whispers dark secrets to its wearer. While attuned to the crown, you can use an action to transform yourself to look like another creature of your general size and shape. This effect lasts for 1 hour or until you use an action to end it.

**Deception.** While wearing the crown, you have advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks.

**Secrets.** The crown has 3 charges and regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. You can expend 1 charge to cast the Detect Thoughts spell (save DC 18).

**False Vision.** As an action, you can expend 2 charges to cast the Mislead spell. Once used, this property can't be used again until the next dawn.

elements.name: Docent
elements.desc:
Wondrous item, Very Rare (Requires Attunement)

A docent is a small, sentient metal sphere that serves as an advisor and guide. It has 3 charges and regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. While holding the docent, you can expend 1 charge to cast the Detect Magic or Identify spell. The docent can also communicate telepathically with you and can speak, read, and understand Common and one other language of the DM's choice.

elements.name: Dragonshard
elements.desc:
Wondrous item, Varies

A dragonshard is a crystalline shard that contains the essence of a dragon. Its properties vary depending on its type (Eberron, Khyber, or Siberys). Eberron dragonshards can be used to enhance spellcasting, Khyber shards can power constructs, and Siberys shards can amplify dragonmarks.

elements.name: Eldritch Machine
elements.desc:
Wondrous item, Varies

Eldritch machines are massive, ancient devices created by the giants of Xen'drik. Their powers are unpredictable and often dangerous, ranging from weather control to planar travel.

elements.name: Elemental Gem
elements.desc:
Wondrous item, Uncommon

This gem contains a mote of elemental energy. When you use an action to break the gem, an elemental is summoned as if you had cast the Conjure Elemental spell, and the gem's magic is lost.

elements.name: Graymatter Engine
elements.desc:
Wondrous item, Very Rare

This pulsating, organic engine is a creation of the mind flayers. It can be used to power a spelljamming helm or other psionic devices. Its use often attracts the attention of aberrations.

elements.name: Graymatter Fluid
elements.desc:
Wondrous item, Uncommon

This viscous, gray fluid is extracted from a graymatter engine. It can be consumed to temporarily enhance psionic abilities, but it carries a risk of madness.

elements.name: ID Crystal
elements.desc:
Wondrous item, Uncommon

This crystal is used by the inhabitants of Wildspace to store and display personal identification and navigation data.

elements.name: Repair Paste
elements.desc:
Wondrous item, Common

This thick, gray paste can be applied to a broken nonmagical object to magically repair it. The paste takes 1 minute to set, after which the object is restored to its original condition.

elements.name: Ring of Feather Falling
elements.desc:
Ring, Rare (Requires Attunement)

When you fall while wearing this ring, you descend 60 feet per round and take no damage from falling.

elements.name: Stone of Good Luck
elements.desc:
Wondrous item, Uncommon (Requires Attunement)

While this polished agate is on your person, you gain a +1 bonus to ability checks and saving throws.

elements.name: Driftglobe
elements.desc:
Wondrous item, Uncommon

This small sphere of thick glass weighs 1 pound. If you are within 60 feet of it, you can speak its command word and cause it to emanate the Light or Daylight spell. Once used, the Daylight effect can’t be used again until the next dawn. You can speak another command word as an action to make the illuminated globe rise into the air and float no more than 5 feet off the ground. The globe hovers in this way until you or another creature grasps it.

elements.name: Necklace of Adaptation
elements.desc:
Wondrous item, Uncommon (Requires Attunement)

While wearing this necklace, you can breathe normally in any environment, and you have advantage on saving throws made against harmful gases and vapors (such as Cloudkill and Stinking Cloud effects, inhaled poisons, and the breath weapons of some dragons).

elements.name: Sword of Sharpness
elements.desc:
Weapon (any sword that deals slashing damage), Very Rare (Requires Attunement)

When you attack an object with this magic sword and hit, maximize your weapon damage dice against the target. When you attack a creature with this weapon and roll a 20 on the attack roll, that target takes an extra 4d6 slashing damage. Then roll another d20. If you roll a 20, you lop off one of the target's limbs, with the effect of such loss determined by the GM.

elements.name: Crystal Ball of Scrying
elements.desc:
Wondrous item, Very Rare (Requires Attunement)

While touching this crystal ball, you can cast the Scrying spell (save DC 17) with it.

elements.name: Tome of Leadership and Influence
elements.desc:
Wondrous item, Very Rare

This book contains guidelines for influencing and charming others, and its words are charged with magic. If you spend 48 hours over a period of 6 days or fewer studying the book's contents and practicing its guidelines, your Charisma score increases by 2, as does your maximum for that score. The manual then loses its magic, but regains it in a century.

elements.name: Manual of Bodily Health
elements.desc:
Wondrous item, Very Rare

This book contains health and diet tips, and its words are charged with magic. If you spend 48 hours over a period of 6 days or fewer studying the book's contents and practicing its guidelines, your Constitution score increases by 2, as does your maximum for that score. The manual then loses its magic, but regains it in a century.

elements.name: All-Purpose Tool
elements.desc:
Wondrous item, Uncommon (+1), Rare (+2), or Very Rare (+3) (Requires Attunement by an Artificer)

This simple screwdriver can transform into a variety of tools. While holding this tool, you gain a bonus to the spell attack rolls and the saving throw DCs of your artificer spells. As an action, you can focus on the tool to channel your creative forces. Choose a cantrip that you don't know from any class list. For 8 hours, you can cast that cantrip, and it counts as an artificer cantrip for you.

elements.name: Wand of Viscid Globs
elements.desc:
Wand, Rare (Requires Attunement)

This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 charge and shoot a glob of viscous, adhesive goo at a creature within 60 feet of you. Make a ranged attack roll. On a hit, the target is restrained for 1 minute. A creature restrained by the goo can use its action to make a Strength check against your spell save DC, escaping on a success. The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn.

elements.name: Shield, +3
elements.desc:
Armor (shield), Very Rare

While holding this shield, you have a +3 bonus to AC. This bonus is in addition to the shield's normal bonus to AC.

elements.name: Survival Mantle
elements.desc:
Wondrous item, Uncommon

This heavy cloak is made of thick, durable fabric. While wearing it, you have advantage on saving throws against extreme cold and extreme heat, and you can survive without food and water for up to 10 days.

elements.name: Staff of Power
elements.desc:
Staff, Very Rare (Requires Attunement by a Sorcerer, Warlock, or Wizard)

This staff can be wielded as a magic quarterstaff that grants a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it. While holding it, you gain a +2 bonus to Armor Class, saving throws, and spell attack rolls. The staff has 20 charges for various spells (Cone of Cold, Fireball, Globe of Invulnerability, etc.).

elements.name: Far Gear
elements.desc:
Wondrous item, Very Rare

This strange device is a piece of advanced technology from a distant world. It functions as a +2 spellcasting focus and allows the user to cast the Misty Step spell once per day.

elements.name: Rod of the Pact Keeper, +3
elements.desc:
Rod, Very Rare (Requires Attunement by a Warlock)

While holding this rod, you gain a +3 bonus to spell attack rolls and to the saving throw DCs of your warlock spells. In addition, you can regain one warlock spell slot as an action while holding the rod. You can't use this property again until you finish a long rest.

elements.name: Amulet of the Devout, +3
elements.desc:
Wondrous item, Very Rare (Requires Attunement by a Cleric or Paladin)

This amulet bears the symbol of a deity. While you wear it, you gain a +3 bonus to spell attack rolls and the saving throw DCs of your spells. In addition, you can use your Channel Divinity feature without expending one of the feature's uses. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

elements.name: Robe of Stars
elements.desc:
Wondrous item, Very Rare (Requires Attunement)

This black or dark blue robe is embroidered with small white or silver stars. You gain a +1 bonus to saving throws while you wear it. Six stars, located on the robe's upper front portion, are particularly large. While wearing this robe, you can use an action to pull off one of the stars and use it to cast Magic Missile as a 5th-level spell. Daily at dusk, 1d6 removed stars reappear on the robe.

elements.name: Flame Tongue
elements.desc:
Weapon (any sword), Rare (Requires Attunement)

You can use a bonus action to speak this magic sword's command word, causing flames to erupt from the blade. These flames shed bright light in a 40-foot radius and dim light for an additional 40 feet. While the sword is ablaze, it deals an extra 2d6 fire damage to any target it hits.

elements.name: Ring of Evasion
elements.desc:
Ring, Rare (Requires Attunement)

This ring has 3 charges, and it regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. When you fail a Dexterity saving throw while wearing it, you can use your reaction to expend 1 of its charges to succeed on that saving throw instead.

elements.name: Lantern of Revealing
elements.desc:
Wondrous item, Uncommon

While lit, this hooded lantern burns for 6 hours on 1 pint of oil, shedding bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet. Invisible creatures and objects are visible as long as they are in the lantern's bright light.

elements.name: Potion of Mind Reading
elements.desc:
Potion, Rare

When you drink this potion, you gain the effect of the Detect Thoughts spell (save DC 13).

elements.name: Spell Scroll
elements.desc:
Scroll, Varies

A spell scroll bears the words of a single spell, written in a mystical cipher. If the spell is on your class's spell list, you can read the scroll and cast its spell without providing any material components. The level of the spell on the scroll determines the spell's saving throw DC and attack bonus, as well as the scroll's rarity. (Specific scrolls found in this adventure include Bless, Protection from Poison, Spiritual Weapon, and Knock.)

elements.name: Head of Vecna
elements.desc:
Wondrous item, Artifact

This preserved, disembodied head of the lich-god Vecna is a powerful and dangerous artifact. It can be used to banish powerful creatures to other planes of existence. Its full powers are determined by the DM.

elements.name: Hand of Vecna
elements.desc:
Wondrous item, Artifact (Requires Attunement)

The Hand of Vecna is a withered, blackened hand. To attune to it, you must sever your own hand and press the artifact to the stump. It grants immense power, including a boost to Strength and the ability to cast powerful spells, but it also corrupts the user.

elements.name: Eye of Vecna
elements.desc:
Wondrous item, Artifact (Requires Attunement)

The Eye of Vecna is a cold, black orb. To attune to it, you must pluck out your own eye and press the artifact into the socket. It grants truesight and the ability to cast powerful divination spells, but it also corrupts the user.

elements.name: Sword of Kas
elements.desc:
Weapon (longsword), Artifact (Requires Attunement)

This legendary sword was created by Vecna for his vampire lieutenant, Kas. It is a +3 longsword that deals an extra 2d10 slashing damage. It also has the ability to drain the life force of its victims and can be used to cast powerful spells. The sword is sentient and seeks to destroy Vecna.

elements.name: Izward's Monstrous Masks
elements.desc:
Wondrous item, Legendary (Requires Attunement by a Druid or Ranger)

This set of masks allows the wearer to wild shape into specific creatures without expending a use of Wild Shape. The set includes the Mask of the Basilisk (Very Rare) and the Mask of the Griffon (Uncommon).

elements.name: Bead of Force
elements.desc:
Wondrous item, Rare

This small black sphere measures 3/4 of an inch in diameter. You can use an action to throw the bead up to 60 feet. The bead explodes on impact, and each creature within a 10-foot radius must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 5d4 force damage. A Sphere of transparent force then encloses the area for 1 minute.

elements.name: Bracers of Defense
elements.desc:
Wondrous item, Rare (Requires Attunement)

While wearing these bracers, you gain a +2 bonus to AC if you are wearing no armor and using no shield.

elements.name: Rod of Rulership
elements.desc:
Rod, Rare (Requires Attunement)

You can use an action to present the rod and command obedience from each creature of your choice that you can see within 120 feet of you. Each target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for 8 hours.

elements.name: Ring of Spell Storing
elements.desc:
Ring, Rare (Requires Attunement)

This ring stores spells cast into it, holding them until the attuned wearer uses them. The ring can store up to 5 levels worth of spells at a time.

elements.name: Rod of the Pact Keeper, +2
elements.desc:
Rod, Rare (Requires Attunement by a Warlock)

While holding this rod, you gain a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls and to the saving throw DCs of your warlock spells. In addition, you can regain one warlock spell slot as an action while holding the rod. You can't use this property again until you finish a long rest.
